Fuel trees (standing timber):
Discounted cash flows: The
valuation model considers the
present value of the net cash flows
expected to be generated by the
plantation. The cash flow
projections include specific
estimates for 8 years. The expected
net cash flows are discounted using
a risk-adjusted discount rate.
Green leaf:
The valuation model considers
the fair value of the the un-
harvested green leaf as at
December 2021. Green leaf
volumes were determined by
taking weighted average of a 14
day plucking cycle using January
2022 data. This was then valued
using the 2021 out-grower
average price.
